desc: Confirm the contribution formula: for each value x with digit length d, its total contribution is x times the sum over subsets of the other N-1 elements of size k of k! (N-1-k)! 10^{sum of digit lengths in the subset}.
Read N and group the integers 1..N by decimal length, storing count c[d] and sum of values sum[d] modulo 998244353 for each length d.
Precompute factorials fact[0..N] and modular inverses inv[1..N] modulo 998244353.
For each digit length d with c[d] > 0, define adjusted counts c'[e] = c[e] - (e == d), and build the generating function P_d(t)=∏_{e}(1+10^e t)^{c'[e]}.
Compute coefficients p_k of P_d(t) up to k=N-1 using the logarithmic-derivative recurrence, exploiting that there are only O(log N) distinct digit lengths.
For each d, compute H_d = ∑_{k=0}^{N-1} fact[k] fact[N-1-k] p_k modulo 998244353, add sum[d] * H_d to the answer, and print the final answer.
Handle edge cases: N=1, digit-length groups with zero count, excluding one element of the current digit length, and modular inverses in the recurrence.
Run the implementation against the provided sample tests and fix any failures.
